test_coverage_gaps.description: No direct tests for readProductMap/writeProductMap localStorage sanitization, CustomEvent dispatch, or immediate cloud-sync call.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: The allocator math is covered, but persistence regressions could make valid mappings disappear or fail to notify table/drawer consumers.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Seed localStorage with malformed values and valid arrays; assert readProductMap drops invalid entries. Spy on dispatchEvent and pushCloudKey when writeProductMap runs.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No direct tests for setMappedProducts dedupe/removal or campaignsForProduct platform scoping.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: These helpers gate which campaigns enter allocation; a scoping regression would show wrong products for same-store cross-platform campaign keys.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Use Meta and TikTok keys for the same store/product, duplicate product IDs, and an empty update; assert dedupe, deletion, and platform-specific lookup.

test_coverage_gaps.description: Allocator lacks explicit all-zero spend tests with non-empty deterministic orders across multiple campaigns.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: The code intentionally falls back to equal split when spend totals are zero; this is a realistic launch/day-zero condition and should stay stable.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Map one product to two same-platform campaigns and two cross-platform campaigns, pass campaignSpend entries of 0, and assert deterministic intra-platform and remainder equal-split behavior.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No sum-to-target conservation assertion over mixed positive deterministic revenue plus negative refund remainder across multiple mapped campaigns.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: Phase 10 fixed refund-heavy mass conservation; a broad epsilon assertion would catch future rounding or clamp regressions without re-flagging the fixed bug.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Product netRevenueCad -150 with one positive Meta order and Meta/TikTok mapped campaigns; assert sum(result.revenue) equals -150 and sum(result.units) equals product units within epsilon.
